units.title: Fundamental of Colour Science
topics: 1.1. Perception of Colour (Light Source,Object and Observer)
1.2. Colour Mixing laws such as additive & subtractive colour mixing.
1.4. Colour attributes such as Hue, Chroma and Value.
1.5. Chromophore and auxochrome groups of dye molecules.
uos: 1.b. Explain colour mixing laws and confusion in colour
1.d. Explain attributes & groups responsible for colour.

uos: 2.c. Understand basic of textile design software.
